question: Discuss the role of ethics and values in enhancing the following three major components of Comprehensive National Power (CNP) viz. human capital, soft power (culture and policies) and social harmony.
Identify ten essential values that are needed to be an effective public servant. Describe ways and means to develop these values in public servants.
“A reliable source of input for decision making is a digital technology source.” Analyse the statement critically.
“Besides domain knowledge, human beings need to have creativity of a high order as well, while resolving ethical dilemmas.” Discuss with a suitable example.

“Every work has got to pass through hundreds of difficulties before success is achieved. Those that persevere will see the light, sooner or later.” — Swami Vivekananda. What does this quotation mean to you?
“We can never obtain peace in the outer world until and unless we obtain peace within ourselves.” — Dalai Lama. What does this quotation mean to you?
“The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others.” — Mahatma Gandhi. What does this quotation mean to you?
“Attitude is an important component that goes towards development of human being. How to build a suitable attitude needed for a public servant?”
In case of conflicts of emotions ethical values help in resolving conflicts. Critically examine.

“Refugees should not be turned back to the country where they would face persecution or human rights violation.” Examine the statement with reference to the ethical dimension being violated when the nation follows the policy of refugees being turned back.
Should impartial and being non-partisan be considered as an indispensable quality to make a successful civil servant? Discuss with illustrations.
An independent and empowered social audit mechanism is an absolute must in every sphere of public service, including judiciary, to ensure performance, accountability and ethical conduct. Elaborate.
“Integrity is a value that empowers the human being.” Justify with suitable illustration.

Sunil is a young civil servant known for competence, integrity and dedication, but faces pressure from an illegal sand mining mafia. Identify the different options available to Sunil, critically evaluate the options and state which would be the most appropriate and why.

As Vice Principal of a degree college, you discover that two lecturers have been involved in helping students during examinations, with political and financial pressures influencing the situation. Discuss the ethical issues and critically examine the options available to you. What option would you adopt and why?

As project manager of an elevated corridor, you discover a serious structural defect that could endanger public safety, while there is pressure to complete the project on schedule. Discuss the ethical dilemmas, professional challenges and consequences of overlooking the defect.
During the COVID-19 pandemic, examine the ethical issues arising from allocation of scarce medical resources and the responsibilities of the state and society.
Discuss the ethical challenges involved in balancing public health measures with individual freedoms during a pandemic.
Examine the ethical issues involved in the use of technology and data for public administration, especially regarding privacy, accountability and public interest.
Discuss the ethical principles that should guide a civil servant when faced with conflicting instructions from superiors, public interest and personal conscience.
